* The events will happen in the order listed on the "[Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalanjiamCubingChallenge2025#competition-schedule)" tab, but event durations are tentative! Check back the day before the competition, as event durations may change depending on the number of competitors in events.

* Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance just in case
